name: session-manager-dev
description: The default end-to-end development skillset for the Claude Code Session Manager: decompose work into scheduler PRDs and track them to a validated finish (/develop), publish releases to npm (/builder), hand a finding to another project on this machine (/send-feedback), and review or drift-check a project's CLAUDE.md/markdown network (/maintaining-md-network). Together with the session-manager scheduler these form a develop → queue → validate → release loop.
